ledger: Man's right arm and hand | holding object against right cheek with curled fingers | holding object against right cheek with curled fingers | teleports to top of head and changes hand pose, then snaps back

findings.description: The man's right arm instantly teleports from his cheek to the top of his head without continuous movement, and his fingers snap from a curled grip to a flat pose in a single frame.
The man's right arm instantly teleports from the top of his head back down to his cheek, and his hand snaps from a flat pose back to a curled grip in a single frame.
